name: Trigger Assistant
description: Rule-based trigger knowledge base + editor UI: auto group allocation, object tagging, and formula-driven trigger generation (3D flip, parallax, etc). Includes an optional "Ask AI" feature (Gemini) for trigger explanations - requires a user-supplied API key in Settings.

show-warnings.name: Show Combination Warnings
show-warnings.description: Show a notification when selected triggers violate a known combination rule (mismatched duration/easing, etc).

gemini-api-key.name: Gemini API Key
gemini-api-key.description: API key tu Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/apikey), dung cho nut "Ask AI" trong Trigger Explainer.
